name: Modern Classics (last 10 years)
source: TMDB /discover/movie — highly rated, with a vote-count floor
note: A query-backed list: membership is re-derived from TMDB rather than fixed, so it stays current without re-seeding. NOTE the name: this sorts by rating, so what it actually returns is recent ACCLAIM, not crowd-pleasing — its lowest entry rates 8.2, while the films people put on for a fun evening (Ace Ventura, Wayne's World) rate 6.6-7.0 and no vote floor can reach them. It was called Crowd-Pleasers until that was measured. The vote_count floor of 5000 is still the right call for what this list IS: /movie/top_rated has no floor, which is why it mixes genuine classics with obscure titles a few fans inflated. A genuinely reach-sorted list is a separate thing, and is in BACKLOG.md.
